/**
 * Helper class for mbox compaction, used to implement
 * nsMsgBrkMBoxStore::AsyncCompact().
 *
 * It iterates through each message in the store, and writes the ones we
 * want to keep into a new mbox file. It'll also patch X-Mozilla-* headers
 * as it goes, if asked to.
 * If all goes well, the old mbox file is replaced by the
 * new one. If any error occurs, the mbox is left untouched.
 * Doesn't fiddle with folder or database or GUI. Just the mbox file.
 * Any higher level database/folder changes are handled by the caller.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 1812 extracts MboxScanner/MboxCompactor from the store implementation without a reported behavior change. Current AsyncCompact obtains a file path and passes it with the listener to the compactor; the compactor retains that listener and starts a scanner, which retains the scan listener. Folder/database commit work belongs to the higher-level caller. The later current compaction strategy is separate chronology and does not follow merely from the file split. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Keep mbox helper file boundaries separate from higher-level folder state
